evidence.note: Agent run nodes, the legend dot and the intact key badge are blue; everything else in the diagram is neutral grey.
The current timeline marker and the highlighted agent's path are blue (focus), past markers turn grey, and the breached lock badge turns red (alarm/loss).
A red dot marks the mirror crash next to the red broken lock; no other red appears.
In the CTF explainer the agent, flag and scorer pill are blue; the blocked attempt ends in a small red x (failure). Neutral greys are used everywhere else.
Once the mirror is rebuilt, the lock badge returns to blue/neutral, so the red state colour clears when the alarm state ends.
Blue appears in the eyebrow, active nav item and progress bar as the accent/focus colour; headings and body text are neutral ink, not red.

rationale: Blue consistently marks focus (agents, current step, active nav) and red appears only on alarm/loss states (breach, crash, failed attempt), clearing when the state resolves. No role colour is used for decoration, and none is used for a different role. That matches the pass descriptor.
